Context.note: Reviewed merged origin/master (W1-W3 latency waves). Items below are architectural defects that were intentionally deferred. Fixes 1-2 (reconnect chain, segmenter reset) already applied.

Fix.title: JobQueue does not actually cancel stale work
Fix.problem: `job_queue.is_stale(job_id)` is checked only AFTER `process_utterance` completes, i.e. after TTS playback already happened. The stale check is just a log line (`stale job #N dropped`) — no work is actually cancelled. The module comment claims "stale work can be canceled" but nothing does.

options.option: Gate TTS playback: hold translated audio until try_commit returns true, drop otherwise. Requires restructure: process_utterance returns audio, commit decision happens before playback.
Remove JobQueue entirely and the stale log lines, keeping only TextSegmenter for delta extraction (simpler, honest).

Fix.verification: Log marker `stale job #N dropped` should never appear after fix (either playback is truly gated or the queue is removed).

Fix.title: Whisper worker hardcodes 16000 Hz sample rate
Fix.problem: `whisper_worker.py` builds a WAV header with hardcoded 16000 Hz (line ~37), but `stt_sample_rate` is a runtime value passed to the Rust session. If sample_rate differs, audio is misinterpreted.
Fix.fix-direction: Include `sample_rate` in the `transcribe` JSON message; worker writes it into the WAV header. Update whisper_stt.rs `send_audio`/`poll_transcript` accordingly.

Fix.title: Whisper worker: no error handling — silent worker death
Fix.problem: No try/except around `transcribe_audio_b64`. If transcription raises (bad audio, model error), the worker dies silently; Rust only notices via the 8s read timeout and must kill/recreate the process. Slow recovery.
Fix.fix-direction: Wrap transcribe in try/except, always `write_msg({"error": ...})` so Rust gets a fast, structured failure instead of a timeout.

Fix.title: local_first preset can panic on unconfigured local MT
Fix.problem: When `local_first: true` is set in settings, Elixir forces STT_PROVIDER=whisper + TRANSLATION_PROVIDER=local_mt. But local MT is feature-gated (build-time `local-mt`) and model paths default to empty. `translate_local_mt` panics (`expect`/`panic!`) inside a worker thread when path is empty.
Fix.fix-direction: Validate in Elixir: if local_mt paths are empty, log error and keep previous provider instead of switching. In Rust, replace panic/expect with `bail!` so the error propagates as a normal translation failure.

Fix.title: Hedge translation burns quota x3 in auto mode
Fix.problem: Auto mode launches Groq + LiteLLM + Yandex in parallel for every utterance; first success wins, the other two requests are wasted. Under metered APIs (Groq rate limits) this triples consumption.
Fix.fix-direction: Consider staggered priorities (Groq first, fallbacks only on failure) or a per-utterance concurrency budget; measure quota impact first.

Fix.title: Windows paths are hardcoded in the Elixir orchestrator
Fix.problem: `base_dir` and `ORT_DYLIB_PATH` are fixed to `C:/Users/Pavel/AppData/Roaming/npm/call-translator-win` (lines around 250, 277 and 326). Any other user gets a wrong engine or onnxruntime path.
Fix.fix-direction: Derive the base directory from the install location (or an env var) and the onnxruntime path from `ORT_DYLIB_PATH` in `.env`, with no per-user default.

Fix.title: Feature local-mt cannot be compiled
Fix.problem: `local-mt = []` declares no dependencies, but the module imports `ct2rs`, which is not in Cargo.toml. `cargo check --features local-mt` fails with unresolved import `ct2rs`. Code behind the feature is therefore never compiled in CI or by hand, and DF-6 changes to translate_local_mt are unverified by the compiler.
Fix.fix-direction: Done: local-mt = ["dep:ct2rs"]. Building it needs RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+crt-static" (ct2rs build.rs forces the static CRT for its C++ part; without the flag link fails with LNK2038). Also needs a short target dir (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=C:\t\lm) because MSVC FileTracker fails on the long worktree path. Verified: cargo test --features local-mt 30/30. Model loading is not exercised (no model files here).
